roleContext.jobDescription: A wealth manager is moving 40,000 client portfolios from its legacy custody system to a new wealth platform over 18 months. The Programme Manager runs the integrated plan across the vendor, operations and technology workstreams, chairs the weekly RAID review, prepares the monthly steering pack and leads readiness sessions with relationship managers and their largest clients before each migration wave. The talent team will share the evidence packet with the steering-committee members who sit on the interview panel. The programme reports to the chief operating officer and has a budget of about £9 million across three years.

requirements.text: Runs an integrated programme plan across vendor, operations and technology workstreams.
Chairs the weekly risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies (RAID) review and tracks actions to closure.
Prepares the monthly steering-committee pack with budget, milestones and decisions required.
Leads readiness sessions with relationship managers and senior wealth clients ahead of migration.
Has delivered a client-data migration in a regulated financial-services firm.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Programme Manager, Wealth Platform Migration

## Experience

- Ran the integrated plan for the replacement of a fund-administration platform at Ashgrove Fund Services from March 2022 to May 2023, coordinating the vendor's build, the operations testing team and the infrastructure group.
- Chaired the weekly RAID review for the same programme, keeping the log in Jira and closing or escalating each action before the next meeting.
- Wrote the monthly steering-committee pack: budget against forecast, milestone status, top risks and the decisions needed from the committee.
- Planned the migration of 9,800 investor accounts to the new administration platform in three tranches, each with a dress rehearsal and a reconciliation sign-off by the operations director.
- Organised internal briefings for the client-service team before each migration tranche.

## Work samples

- Work sample: an anonymised steering-committee pack for one month of the programme, showing budget against forecast, the milestone chart, the top five risks with owners and two decisions requested from the committee.
